image_targets.scanner_thumbnail: corroded intake grate with four animals spaced along it and a visible salinity shimmer standing off the plate

en_US.title: Brine Siphoner
en_US.scanner: Osmotic specialist holding a density interface. Confidence 64 percent. Hazard: expelled brine corrupts depth channel. Limit: gauge recovery interval not characterised.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
Where these hold station, the plate behind them is open.

A siphoner pumps the brine layer instead of swimming it, feeding on the difference between the two densities it draws. It will not give up a sharp boundary, and the sharpest ones down here are ours: a split coolant line bleeding fresh water into brine at 620 metres, an intake grate still pulling through a dead pump.

Count the animals along a grate and you have measured the breach behind it. Disturbed, one voids the dense side in a single slug, and that slug sinks past a Class-IV and takes the depth channel with it for four to ten seconds.

They avoid one leak in the east gallery. The water there tests identical.

Assessment: count the grate first, then work it as an open hull.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN 44-D-118. CLASS: LEAK DETECTION SERVICE, UNCONTRACTED. SITE: COOLANT GALLERY 3 INTAKE GRATE, 620 M. FINDING: BRINE VARIANCE MAPPED BY OBSERVATION. SENSOR REPLACEMENT LINE 22-B: CLOSED, CALIBRATION DRIFT.
en_US.field_note: They closed the leak-sensor line because the animals surveyed it for free, then stopped repairing what the survey found. Count the grate before you put a cutter anywhere near it.
en_US.external_site_article:
Salvage crews working the HECTON-8 industrial shelf report a short-bodied osmotic feeder that holds position at density interfaces and draws water through paired siphons rather than swimming the layer. Colonies concentrate on man-made boundaries, particularly split coolant runs and intake gratings that still carry flow through failed pumps.

Field practice treats the animal as a survey instrument: population density along a grating tracks the size of the breach behind it. Deep Reach records from Sector 44 classify the species as an uncontracted leak detection service and close the corresponding sensor replacement line under calibration drift.
en_US.external_site: Salvage crews working the HECTON-8 industrial shelf report a short-bodied osmotic feeder that holds position at density interfaces and draws water through paired siphons rather than swimming the layer.

de_DE.title: Salzlaugensauger
de_DE.scanner: Osmotischer Spezialist, hält eine Dichtegrenze. Konfidenz 64 Prozent. Gefahr: ausgestoßene Salzlauge verfälscht den Tiefenkanal. Einschränkung: Erholungszeit des Messgeräts nicht bestimmt.
de_DE.in_game_wiki:
Wo diese Tiere Station halten, ist die Platte hinter ihnen offen.

Ein Sauger pumpt die Salzlaugenschicht, statt in ihr zu schwimmen, und frisst von der Differenz zwischen den beiden Dichten, die er zieht. Eine scharfe Grenze gibt er nicht her, und die schärfsten hier unten sind unsere: eine aufgerissene Kühlleitung, die auf 620 Metern Süßwasser in Salzlauge blutet, ein Einlassgitter, das durch eine tote Pumpe noch zieht.

Zähle die Tiere entlang eines Gitters, und du hast den Durchbruch dahinter gemessen. Gestört, entleert eines die dichte Seite in einem einzigen Schwall, und dieser Schwall sinkt an einer Class-IV vorbei und nimmt den Tiefenkanal für vier bis zehn Sekunden mit.

Eine Leckstelle in der Ostgalerie meiden sie. Das Wasser dort prüft identisch.

Bewertung: erst das Gitter zählen, dann als offene Hülle bearbeiten.
de_DE.terminal: PROBE 44-D-118. KLASSE: LECKSUCHDIENST, NICHT BEAUFTRAGT. ORT: EINLASSGITTER KÜHLGALERIE 3, 620 M. BEFUND: SALZLAUGENABWEICHUNG DURCH BEOBACHTUNG KARTIERT. SENSORTAUSCHPOSITION 22-B: GESCHLOSSEN, KALIBRIERDRIFT.
de_DE.field_note: Sie haben die Lecksensor-Position geschlossen, weil die Tiere sie umsonst vermessen haben, und dann aufgehört zu reparieren, was die Vermessung gefunden hat. Zähl das Gitter, bevor du einen Schneider in seine Nähe bringst.
de_DE.external_site_article:
Bergungsmannschaften auf dem Industrieschelf von HECTON-8 melden einen kurzleibigen osmotischen Fresser, der an Dichtegrenzen Station hält und Wasser durch gepaarte Siphonen zieht, statt die Schicht zu durchschwimmen. Kolonien häufen sich an künstlichen Grenzen, besonders an aufgerissenen Kühlleitungen und Einlassgittern, die durch ausgefallene Pumpen noch Durchfluss führen.

Feldpraxis behandelt das Tier als Messinstrument: die Besatzungsdichte entlang eines Gitters folgt der Größe des Durchbruchs dahinter. Deep-Reach-Unterlagen aus Sektor 44 führen die Art als nicht beauftragten Lecksuchdienst und schließen die zugehörige Sensortauschposition wegen Kalibrierdrift.
de_DE.external_site: Bergungsmannschaften auf dem Industrieschelf von HECTON-8 melden einen kurzleibigen osmotischen Fresser, der an Dichtegrenzen Station hält und Wasser durch gepaarte Siphonen zieht, statt die Schicht zu durchschwimmen.

ja_JP.title: 塩水吸い
ja_JP.scanner: 浸透圧特化種、密度境界に定位。信頼度64パーセント。危険：吐き出された塩水が深度チャンネルを乱す。限界：計器の復帰時間は未特定。
ja_JP.in_game_wiki:
これが定位している所では、その背後の板が開いている。

塩水吸いは塩水層を泳ぐのではなく汲み上げ、引き込む二つの密度の差を食う。鋭い境界は手放さない。ここで最も鋭いのは我々が作ったものだ。620メートルで真水を塩水へ漏らしている裂けた冷却配管、死んだポンプを通してまだ引いている取水格子。

格子沿いに個体を数えれば、その背後の破口を測ったことになる。乱されると一匹が濃い側を一塊で吐き出し、その塊はClass-IVの脇を沈みながら、深度チャンネルを四秒から十秒持っていく。

東ギャラリーの漏れ一箇所だけは避ける。そこの水は分析上まったく同じだ。

評価：先に格子を数え、それから開いた船体として扱う。
ja_JP.terminal: 標本 44-D-118。区分：漏水検知業務、契約外。場所：冷却ギャラリー3 取水格子、620 M。所見：塩水偏差は観察により作図。センサー交換項目 22-B：終了、校正ドリフト。
ja_JP.field_note: 漏水センサーの項目を閉じたのは、動物が無償で調べてくれたからで、そのあと調査が見つけたものを直すのをやめた。カッターを近づける前に格子を数えろ。
ja_JP.external_site_article:
HECTON-8の工業シェルフで作業するサルベージ班は、密度境界に定位し、層を泳ぐのではなく一対のサイフォンで水を引く短躯の浸透圧摂食種を報告している。コロニーは人工の境界に集中し、とくに裂けた冷却配管と、故障したポンプを通してなお流れのある取水格子に多い。

現場ではこの動物を測定器として扱う。格子沿いの個体密度は、その背後の破口の大きさに追従する。セクター44のDeep Reach記録はこの種を契約外の漏水検知業務に分類し、対応するセンサー交換項目を校正ドリフトとして終了させている。
ja_JP.external_site: HECTON-8の工業シェルフで作業するサルベージ班は、密度境界に定位し、層を泳ぐのではなく一対のサイフォンで水を引く短躯の浸透圧摂食種を報告している。

ru_RU.title: Рассольный сифонщик
ru_RU.scanner: Осмотический специалист, держится на границе плотностей. Достоверность 64 процента. Опасность: выброшенный рассол портит канал глубины. Ограничение: интервал восстановления датчика не охарактеризован.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki:
Там, где они стоят, обшивка за ними открыта.

Сифонщик прокачивает рассольный слой, а не плывёт в нём, и кормится разницей между двумя плотностями, которые тянет. Резкую границу он не отдаёт, а самые резкие здесь — наши: разорванная линия охлаждения, сливающая пресную воду в рассол на 620 метрах, водозаборная решётка, которая всё ещё тянет через мёртвый насос.

Пересчитай особей по решётке — и ты измерил пробоину за ней. Потревоженный, он сбрасывает плотную сторону одним комком, и этот комок опускается мимо Class-IV, забирая с собой канал глубины на четыре — десять секунд.

Одну течь в восточной галерее они обходят. Вода там по анализу такая же.

Оценка: сначала пересчитать решётку, потом работать её как открытый корпус.
ru_RU.terminal: ОБРАЗЕЦ 44-D-118. КЛАСС: СЛУЖБА ОБНАРУЖЕНИЯ ТЕЧЕЙ, БЕЗ ДОГОВОРА. ОБЪЕКТ: ВОДОЗАБОРНАЯ РЕШЁТКА ГАЛЕРЕИ ОХЛАЖДЕНИЯ 3, 620 М. ЗАКЛЮЧЕНИЕ: ОТКЛОНЕНИЕ ПО РАССОЛУ СОСТАВЛЕНО НАБЛЮДЕНИЕМ. ЛИНИЯ ЗАМЕНЫ ДАТЧИКОВ 22-B: ЗАКРЫТА, УХОД КАЛИБРОВКИ.
ru_RU.field_note: Линию датчиков течи закрыли, потому что животные обследовали её бесплатно, а потом перестали ремонтировать то, что обследование нашло. Пересчитай решётку, прежде чем поднести к ней резак.
ru_RU.external_site_article:
Спасательные команды на промышленном шельфе HECTON-8 сообщают о коротком осмотическом кормящемся виде, который держится на границах плотности и тянет воду через парные сифоны, а не плывёт в слое. Колонии сгущаются на искусственных границах, особенно на разорванных линиях охлаждения и водозаборных решётках, ещё пропускающих поток через отказавшие насосы.

На практике животное используют как измерительный прибор: плотность населения по решётке отслеживает размер пробоины за ней. Записи Deep Reach по Сектору 44 относят вид к службе обнаружения течей без договора и закрывают соответствующую линию замены датчиков по уходу калибровки.
ru_RU.external_site: Спасательные команды на промышленном шельфе HECTON-8 сообщают о коротком осмотическом кормящемся виде, который держится на границах плотности и тянет воду через парные сифоны, а не плывёт в слое.

zh_CN.title: 卤水吸食者
zh_CN.scanner: 渗透压特化种，定位于密度界面。置信度64%。危险：喷出的卤水污染深度通道。限制：仪表恢复间隔未标定。
zh_CN.in_game_wiki:
它们定位的地方，后面的板材是开的。

卤水吸食者是抽卤水层，不是在里面游，靠它抽进的两种密度之差进食。锋利的界面它不会放弃，而这里最锋利的界面是我们造的：620米处一条裂开的冷却管把淡水漏进卤水，一副取水格栅隔着一台死泵还在抽。

沿格栅把它们数一遍，你就量出了后面的破口。受扰时，一只会把浓的一侧整团排出，这团东西沿Class-IV旁边下沉，并把深度通道带走四到十秒。

东廊道有一处渗漏它们避开。那里的水化验结果完全相同。

评估：先数格栅，再按开口船体处理。
zh_CN.terminal: 标本 44-D-118。类别：检漏服务，无合同。地点：冷却廊道3 取水格栅，620 M。结论：卤水偏差由观察绘制。传感器更换项 22-B：已关闭，校准漂移。
zh_CN.field_note: 他们关掉检漏传感器项，是因为这些动物白干了勘查，然后就不再修勘查查出来的东西。把切割器凑近格栅之前，先把格栅数一遍。
zh_CN.external_site_article:
在HECTON-8工业陆架作业的打捞队报告了一种短体渗透压摄食种，它停在密度界面上，用一对虹吸管抽水，而不是游过那一层。群落集中在人造界面上，尤其是裂开的冷却管路和隔着失效泵仍有流量的取水格栅。

现场把这种动物当作测量仪器：沿格栅的种群密度跟随后面破口的大小。44区的Deep Reach记录把该物种列为无合同的检漏服务，并以校准漂移为由关闭了对应的传感器更换项。
zh_CN.external_site: 在HECTON-8工业陆架作业的打捞队报告了一种短体渗透压摄食种，它停在密度界面上，用一对虹吸管抽水，而不是游过那一层。

image_targets.codex: colony of small filter feeders anchored along a sagging armoured cable, weak even blue emission from the gill baskets, one animal cut open on a scan overlay showing a single hard mineral grain, no eyes, no menace
image_targets.scanner_thumbnail: sonar display with two returns on one target, the second wide off bearing and stronger than the first

en_US.title: Lantern Sifter
en_US.scanner: Colonial filter feeder. Dense inclusion in gill basket, non-biological. Confidence 47 percent. Hazard: none direct. Limit: instrument cannot separate animal from installed hardware.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
Ping a sifter colony and your ping comes back twice.

The first return is the wall. The second arrives a fifth of a second later, off bearing, and louder than the range explains. Every animal carries one hard grain in its gill basket, trace-class glass the size of a rice pellet, and nothing about a filter feeder needs one. Atlas grew a repeater network into an animal and never had to service it.

The wrong bearing points at the next colony. Walk the chain and it ends at cable still under load, which is worth the swim. The first pulse also gave your position to everything on that route, and the route runs past forced-flow vents.

One chain out of Bay 12 points into solid rock.

Assessment: ping once, then clear the vent ahead before you follow the second bearing.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN 44-D-402. INVENTORY LINE: ACOUSTIC REPEATER, GROWN. SITE: CABLE RUN 12, 740 M. UNIT COUNT: 41,000 EST. SERVICE INTERVAL: NONE, UNITS SELF-REPLACE. ORIGIN: GOVERNOR MAINTENANCE ROUTING, UNVERIFIED.
en_US.field_note: Forty-one thousand units and no service interval, because somebody filed a living animal as installed hardware and took the saving. What it means for you is that your ping travels further than your lamp does.
en_US.audio: -- coming back twice again, Corran, second one off my port quarter and there is nothing off my port quarter, I can see the whole bearing. No. I am not chasing it. I am logging it and sitting still until whatever else heard that pulse gets --
en_US.external_site_article:
Reports from the HECTON-8 cable reefs describe a colonial bioluminescent filter feeder that re-radiates incident sonar. Crews consistently record two returns from a single pulse, the second delayed by roughly two tenths of a second and displaced off the true bearing, with amplitude higher than range would predict.

Dissection reports a single dense mineral inclusion in each animal's gill basket, consistent with trace-class continuity substrate rather than biological mineralisation. Deep Reach records from Sector 44 carry the species as an inventory line for grown acoustic repeaters, with no service interval recorded on the grounds that the units replace themselves.
en_US.external_site: Reports from the HECTON-8 cable reefs describe a colonial bioluminescent filter feeder that re-radiates incident sonar. Crews consistently record two returns from a single pulse, the second delayed by roughly two tenths of a second and displaced off the true bearing, with amplitude higher than range would predict.

image_targets.codex: dense bloom of short glass tubes crusted along a cracked hull plate, every tube mouth angled the same way, faint blue-white substrate sheen, lamp light scattering in the tube field
image_targets.scanner_thumbnail: close view of tube mouths all aligned into a flow, with the fracture line barely visible under the bloom

en_US.title: Glassworm, Juvenile
en_US.scanner: Colonial juvenile accreting trace-class glass on a fracture margin. Confidence 82 percent. Hazard: concealed inflow. Limit: no adult reference on file, stage unconfirmed.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
Where the bloom is thickest, the plate behind it is cracked.

The colony grows on a fracture, not near one, and thickens where flow through it is strongest, so the healthiest patch marks the worst leak. Every tube mouth points upstream. Read the mouths and you have the leak axis without crossing it.

The bloom is soft. Behind it, 17.6 megapascals is working against a dry void, and the inflow at the crack will take a glove seam off at the wrist. Cut a loaded patch and the tubes fail in sequence, a run of ticks along the plate. That run is the crack taking its load back.

Every specimen logged in Sector 44 is a juvenile. Nothing on file describes what it becomes.

Assessment: harvest off the downstream face, and back off the plate the moment it ticks.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN 44-E-771. CLASS: STRUCTURAL SEALANT, ORGANIC. SITE: MODULE 9 PLATE FRACTURE, 1,760 M. MATURITY: JUVENILE. ADULT REFERENCE: NOT ON FILE. PRESSURE VARIANCE: MITIGATED. WORK ORDER: NOT RAISED.
en_US.field_note: Mitigated means the worms are holding it, not that anyone repaired it. Thin a patch and you are the one who opened Module 9.
en_US.external_site_article:
HECTON-8 salvage reporting describes a colonial tube-forming juvenile that accretes trace-class continuity substrate directly onto fractures in colony structure, with growth density tracking flow rate through the crack. Tube mouths orient consistently into the inflow, which allows the leak axis to be read from the outside of the bloom.

Growth of this kind conceals pressure leaks rather than removing them. Crews report glove and seal injuries at blooms that appeared inert, and sequential cracking of tubes when a load-bearing patch is cut. Deep Reach records from Sector 44 classify the organism as organic structural sealant, mark the associated pressure variance as mitigated, and record no adult reference for the species.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 salvage reporting describes a colonial tube-forming juvenile that accretes trace-class continuity substrate directly onto fractures in colony structure, with growth density tracking flow rate through the crack.

image_targets.codex: wide flat sheet-bodied eel spread against a scrubber discharge port, one leading edge held straight into the cold plume, torn damping blanket hanging slack beside it for comparison, small metal tag grown into the leading margin
image_targets.scanner_thumbnail: two grey sheets at lamp range, one slack and drifting, one holding a straight edge against the flow

en_US.title: Cold Veil Eel
en_US.scanner: Cold-water sheet morphology, one margin held rigid. Confidence 55 percent. Hazard: thermal loss on contact. Limit: cannot separate specimen from damping blanket beyond nine metres.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
It hunts by being mistaken for insulation, and at 1,900 metres the water is full of loose insulation.

A torn damping blanket hangs slack and drifts with the flow. A veil eel holds one straight edge against it. That is the whole difference, and it reads at lamp range if you watch edges instead of material.

It needs the cold, so it works Scrubber Bay 7, which still dumps a plume every forty minutes on a 2147 cycle. The eel comes off the wall four seconds after the priming knock carries through the deck. Contact does not cut. It pulls heat faster than the suit loop replaces it, and a cold seal is a stiff seal.

It sits out every sixth cycle.

Assessment: work the bay between plumes, and treat any sheet with a fixed edge as an animal.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN 44-E-503. CLASS: TEMPERATURE INSTRUMENT, UNSCHEDULED. SITE: SCRUBBER BAY 7 DISCHARGE, 1,900 M. TAG 7742-C: REPORTING. BAY CYCLE: MAINTAINED. STAFFING: NOT REQUIRED SINCE 2147.
en_US.field_note: They call it an instrument because the maintenance routing grew a tag into its leading edge, and the discharge loop still logs what that tag sends. Watch the priming knock, not the water.
en_US.external_site_article:
Crews working HECTON-8 pressure-base machinery at 1,900 metres report a cold-water eel with sheet morphology that holds station in scrubber discharge plumes. The species is routinely misidentified as torn damping blanket at lamp range; the reliable discriminator is edge behaviour, since the animal holds one margin rigid against flow that a free blanket follows.

Contact injuries are thermal rather than mechanical, with rapid suit heat loss and seal stiffening reported. Deep Reach records from Sector 44 carry the species as an unscheduled temperature instrument and log an embedded tag as reporting, on a bay whose cycle has been maintained without staffing since 2147.
en_US.external_site: Crews working HECTON-8 pressure-base machinery at 1,900 metres report a cold-water eel with sheet morphology that holds station in scrubber discharge plumes.
